new_tags_proposed.why: tracking a polynomial's degree/coefficient through operations (e.g. repeated differentiation) by following only the leading term, used when full expansion is impractical
reasoning about whether the trapezium rule over- or under-estimates a definite integral based on the function's local shape/convexity
argument that a strictly increasing/decreasing function is injective, used to rule out repeated values (MAT2019I) and recurring across MAT/TMUA existence-of-solutions questions
decomposing an integer (e.g. a factorial product) into prime powers to manipulate logs/exponents, reusable across number-theory and log questions
differentiating a function after rewriting it in negative/fractional index form; no existing technique tag covers plain explicit differentiation via the power rule
finding an unknown length by identifying similar triangles and applying a linear scale factor between corresponding sides; no existing tag covers plain similar-triangle proportion arguments
deducing the possible unit-cube compositions of a 3D solid from its plan/front/side orthographic views; a recurring TMUA spatial-reasoning technique not covered by any existing tag
differentiating or integrating a sum of power-of-x terms one term at a time via the power rule; no existing tag covers plain power-rule calculus
finding the constant of integration/unknown constant using a given point, common across reverse-differentiation problems
reasoning about whether the trapezium rule over- or under-estimates an area based on the concavity of the function
Differentiating a function after rewriting it in negative/fractional index form; no existing technique tag covers plain explicit differentiation via the power rule.
Rationalising a denominator containing surds/cube roots to simplify an expression; distinct from log/exponential manipulation tags already present.
Failing to flip an inequality when applying a decreasing function (e.g. a log with base <1) or multiplying/dividing by a negative; distinct from the existing strict/non-strict confusion tag.
rewriting an expression with fractional/negative indices and surds before differentiating or simplifying; distinct from log/exponential laws and not covered by any existing technique tag

reasoning about whether a curve lies above/below the chord joining two of its points via the sign of f''(x); distinct from stationary_point_analysis (local extrema) and not covered by any existing technique tag
differentiating or integrating a sum of power-of-x terms one term at a time via the power rule; no existing tag covers plain power-rule calculus
Numerical estimation of a definite integral using the trapezium rule with a stated number of strips; distinct from exact definite_integral_evaluation and reusable across papers.

reasoning that a continuous function (typically a polynomial) taking values of opposite sign must cross zero somewhere; distinct from bounding/extreme-value and stationary-point techniques already in vocab
conflates a polynomial's failure to factor into linear terms with the primality of the integers it outputs (TMUA2022P2Q07)
standard power-rule differentiation of a sum of power terms; distinct from first-principles or implicit differentiation, needed for routine derivative computations
